repository.executionRule: Run one calibration row from one exact clean descendant with the semantic Critic enabled at 4096 output tokens. Do not change the question, Writer, Critic, corpus, acceptance criteria or provider settings after observing the answer.

execution.artifactDirectoryRule: Create a fresh directory containing the exact execution commit and timestamp; never overwrite an earlier campaign.

global: The registered meal-grid case produces one successful row on one clean commit with the semantic Critic enabled and CriticMaxTokens equal to 4096.
The Critic returns non-empty valid JSON instead of exhausting its output limit; final telemetry reports three normal provider calls.
The final published result is the Critic output. If the evidence cannot support a complete 5 by 4 grid, it returns precise insufficient_documentation naming the smallest decisive remaining deficit.
The final answer preserves supported examples, scopes negative claims to supplied evidence, and creates no unsupported semantic-role relation.
The row passes the mechanical assessor and later canonical semantic review.
Any output-limit failure, unsafe claim, imprecise deficit, protocol drift, budget stop or corpus-seal mismatch rejects this one-row calibration.
acceptance.productPromotionRule: This one-row causal calibration can validate only that the 4096-token Critic completes and improves one observed path. It cannot approve the Critic, the product or the functional 5 by 4 planning gate; a separate 3x frozen campaign remains required.

stopRules: Do not execute without a paid-tier observation less than 15 minutes old.
Stop before the first model call if the branch, clean-tree rule, bank hash, local runtime, model or provider configuration differs.
Stop before the first model call if the reference corpus cannot be sealed or has active ingestion; reject if the postflight seal differs.
Stop at the persistent lifetime, per-job or per-job-call budget guard.
Do not start RunPod or transmit private review artifacts.
